name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Strawberry Lemonade
description: Bright, sweet, and made for lemonade lovers. Double-Stacked Strawberry Lemonade BITEZ pair juicy, ripe strawberry with bright, zesty lemonade for a refreshing sweet-and-tart flavor that keeps every chew deliciously balanced. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A summertime classic stacked with serious potency.
